words.meaning: The quality of being cautious, wise, and judicious in practical affairs.
words.sentence1: Prudence guided her through the difficult financial negotiations. (Prudence guided her through the difficult financial negotiations.)
words.sentence2: It takes great prudence to know when to speak and when to remain silent. (It takes great prudence to know when to speak and when to remain silent.)

words.meaning: Wisdom, good judgment, and common sense.
words.sentence1: Su gran sensatez ayudó a resolver el conflicto familiar. (His great good sense helped resolve the family conflict.)
words.sentence2: Actuó con mucha sensatez ante la crisis inesperada. (He acted with a lot of common sense facing the unexpected crisis.)

words.meaning: Clear-sightedness, profound discernment, and intellectual wisdom.
words.sentence1: Il a analysé la situation avec une grande clairvoyance. (He analyzed the situation with great clear-sightedness.)
words.sentence2: La clairvoyance du leader a sauvé l'entreprise de la faillite. (The leader's discernment saved the company from bankruptcy.)

words.sentence1: In gefährlichen Momenten bewahrte sie stets ihre Besonnenheit. (In dangerous moments she always maintained her circumspection.)
words.sentence2: Seine Besonnenheit macht ihn zu einem geschätzten Ratgeber. (His calm reflection makes him a valued advisor.)

words.meaning: Prudence, restraint, and thoughtful consideration for others.
words.sentence1: Kare wa enryo naku iken o nobeta. (He expressed his opinion without hesitation.)
words.sentence2: Sono basho de no enryo wa hitsuyō de aru. (Discretion is necessary in that place.)

words.sentence1: Con grande avvedutezza, decise di investire nel progetto a lungo termine. (With great shrewdness, he decided to invest in the long-term project.)
words.sentence2: La sua avvedutezza evitò molti problemi futuri. (Her wise foresight avoided many future problems.)

words.meaning: Deep philosophical insight and intellectual brightness.
words.sentence1: Tā de wénzhāng chōngmǎn le lǐxìng de cíxīng. (His article is full of rational insight.)
words.sentence2: Zhè shǒu shī tǐxiàn le gǔrén de zhéxué cíxīng. (This poem reflects the philosophical wisdom of the ancients.)

words.meaning: Clarity of mind and profound philosophical understanding.
words.sentence1: Geuui suneun hyeolmyeongeuro gadeuk cha isseotda. (His thoughts were filled with profound clarity.)
words.sentence2: Uriwa hamkke hyeolmyeongeul chaja naseja. (Let's set out together to find philosophical truth.)

words.sentence1: Neak prachanh mean panya khpuos. (The philosopher possesses high wisdom.)
words.sentence2: Panya chea treuvkar samkhan samrab chivit. (Wisdom is an important need for life.)

words.sentence1: Sy bedagsaamheid teenoor ander is merkwaardig. (His thoughtfulness toward others is remarkable.)
words.sentence2: Deur die eensaamheid het hy groot bedagsaamheid gekry. (Through solitude he attained great thoughtfulness.)
